title: The Classified Seconds That Almost Ended Humanity: 1983 Soviet nuclear false alarm incident
logline: At the height of the Cold War, early-warning satellites reported five incoming nuclear warheads — leaving one Soviet officer with twenty minutes to obey military protocol or risk three hundred million lives.

thumbnail_concept.visual_composition: IMAX 70mm composition: Extreme chiaroscuro. In foreground, trembling silhouette of a military officer's hand hovering inches above a glowing crimson authorization switch. scenes.timeline_thread: Convergence Point: The Decision of Disobedience (T-Minus 0)
scenes.audio_text: He had a direct line to the Kremlin. His finger hovered over the confirmation switch. But instead of following orders... (pausa: 2s) Petrov decided to trust a hunch. If the United States was going to start World War Three... why send only five missiles?
